name: QuietBox 2 vs DGX Spark
description: Benchmark harness and published results comparing a Tenstorrent QuietBox 2 against one and two NVIDIA DGX Sparks and Apple hardware on open-weight models. Workloads are shaped like coding-agent traffic, from short chat turns to 128K-context prefill, measuring time to first token, per-user decode speed, aggregate throughput, and wall power and tokens per joule from a smart plug. Any machine with an OpenAI-compatible server can be added.
author: Justin Garrison
